doctrine.title: Project Controls Doctrine
doctrine.summary: One controlled model, preserved baseline, traceable measurement, schedule logic before appearance, and calm management reporting using Fact -> Implication -> Action.
principles: Excel is the quantity/commercial/progress authority; Microsoft Project is the schedule/CPM authority; Web/PDF are presentation layers.
The baseline is preserved. Routine status updates do not silently overwrite it.
Actual progress stops at the Data Date; anything beyond the Data Date is forecast.
Measured quantities drive progress and payment claims, with reconciliation and overclaim checks.
Delay-days are not automatically project-delay days; controlling-path impact governs forecast completion.
Management reporting is concise: Fact -> Implication -> Action, with evidence available for audit.

documentControl.controlNote: This presentation is ISO-management-system compatible in structure but does not claim Kubota Construction procedure compliance or certification.

isoAlignment.assessmentControls: Document ID/revision/status, traceable WBS/Activity/BOQ IDs, measurement verification, baseline/change history, reconciliation checks and review evidence.
Environmental/permit constraints can be registered as schedule interfaces or hold points, with ownership, dates and evidence traceable to WBS/activity records.
Safety permits, method statements and prerequisite controls can be represented as readiness gates; resequencing must not bypass required safety controls.
